text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Among the voices rooting for Ines<n>Fujin to win the
Satsuki Sho, one<n>resonates in particular. A certain
fan<n>is cheering her on because they want<n>to see
their dream in her.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Around this time, Ines Fujin receives<n>some
encouragement from her<n>younger sisters—whom
she imagines<n>are dancing their hearts out—and her
morale gets a huge boost.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Satsuki Sho arrives.<n>With Ines
Fujin's popularity surging,<n>the number of
opponents ready to<n>mark her is probably on the rise
too.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Among those opponents is her friend,<n>Mejiro Ryan.
The two burn with a<n>passionate rivalry as the
curtains rise<n>on a sparking hot Satsuki Sho!
